xmldoc.short_description: Customize dot indexing of a class.

param_input_item.param_description: an object of a class deriving from nelson.mixin.indexing.RedefinesDot.

param_output_item.param_description: an object supporting customized dot indexing.

description.p: Derive from nelson.mixin.indexing.RedefinesDot to give a class its own dot indexing behavior for names that are not declared properties or methods. A subclass implements the protected methods dotReference(obj, indexOp) (value of obj.name), dotAssign(obj, indexOp, value) (obj.name = value) and dotListLength(obj, indexOp, indexContext).
indexOp is a nelson.indexing.IndexingOperation whose Name property holds the accessed name. Declared properties and methods keep their normal behavior; only unknown names call dotReference/dotAssign.
